F1: The public members route makes one `findMembers()` call that now defaults to 50 members, and `group/members.hbs` has no paging or load-more, so anyone past the first 50 can't be reached.
F2: remove_member` calls `group.users.delete(user_id)` and never clears `primary_group_id`, which the old cleanup in `destroy_deletions` did, so a removed user can keep the group as their primary group.
F3: Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1` gives 2 pages for exactly 50 members, so Next is enabled and asks for offset 50, which returns an empty list.
